claims: BTS leader RM has suffered an accessory navicular sprain, a partial ligament tear, and a talus contusion during rehearsal on March 19, 2026.
RM's movements will be limited at BTS's comeback concert.
RM plans to perform while seated at BTS's comeback concert.
RM's injury is a left ankle injury involving a sprain, partial ligament tear, and bruising/inflammation.
RM sustained the injury during a performance rehearsal on March 19, 2026.
Medical staff advised minimizing movement for at least two weeks.
Recovery plan requires RM to wear a cast.
RM's participation in choreography for the upcoming comeback concert will be partially limited.
RM will perform while seated for the comeback show.
RM will perform in a limited capacity for the comeback show.
RM reassured fans via social media that it is not a very serious injury.
RM stated via social media that he plans to be ready for future schedules
